newsitem.title: USA: Pratt says wins $290mln engine orders.
newsitem.headline: Pratt says wins $290mln engine orders.

text.p: Pratt & Whitney, a unit of United Technologies Corp, said on Thursday it won engine orders worth about $290 million from Swissair and Sabena of Belgium.
The airlines chose Pratt PW4168 engines for their new fleets of Airbus Industrie A330-200 aircraft, Pratt said in a statement.
Swissair will take nine of the twin-engine jets, and Sabena will acquire four, Pratt said.
Deliveries of the new Airbus Industrie A330s, which will eventually replace the current A310 fleets at both airlines, will begin in 1998.
The order increases Pratt's worldwide market share in A330 engines to 57 percent from 50 percent, said Mark Sullivan, Pratt spokesman.
Sullivan told Reuters that Pratt has this year won about 75 percent of the A330 engine competitions, up from a previous 70 percent.
